me.title: About Me
me.description: Learn more about my background, skills, and experience.
content: I'm a Tech Lead at Leroy Merlin (through Develcode). I have more than four years of experience where I work with the languages and tools HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, React, GitHub, Datadog and others.

My main skills are the development of websites, web applications, static sites with good clean code practices, performance, unit tests, debugging techniques, project documentation and production of tutorials.
I am also responsible for semantic versioning of the project, controlling environments and deployment with GitHub Actions, and planning and demonstrating deliveries.
Furthermore, I participated in the implementation of observability in Datadog RUM in React applications, contributing to improving the user experience and optimizing application resources.

I have a degree in Systems Analysis and Development from FATEC and an IT technician from ETEC. I am passionate about web application development and automation, and I am always looking to learn new technologies and methodologies.

I am a committed, creative, and collaborative professional, who likes to work as a team and solve problems. I am proud to have been awarded at two innovation events, Ideathon and Inovathon São Paulo, where I presented solutions to the challenges of the digital environment and culture and tourism. My goal is to continue developing solutions that generate value for customers and society.
